# Let's analyze this problem:
# - 16 vertices total
# - Exactly 3 vertex-disjoint cliques, each of size 3
# - Every vertex must belong to one of these cliques
# - Only edges are within these cliques

# Check feasibility:
# 3 cliques × 3 vertices each = 9 vertices
# But we have 16 vertices total
# 16 ≠ 9, so we CANNOT cover all 16 vertices with exactly 3 cliques of size 3

print("Number of vertices:", 16)
print("Number of cliques:", 3)
print("Size of each clique:", 3)
print("Vertices covered by cliques:", 3 * 3)
print("Vertices remaining uncovered:", 16 - 3 * 3)
print()
print("Since every vertex must belong to one of the cliques,")
print("and 3 cliques × 3 vertices = 9 vertices ≠ 16 vertices,")
print("this is UNSATISFIABLE.")
